style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

qualityCriteria.definitionOfGood: Organic hollow pink/violet coral with rounded substantial rims, soft symmetric light, readable purposeful details and grounded gentle sway, coherent in all4facings and intended sizes.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: Recognizable tiered, fanning hollow coral fingers with more organic swell/taper and soft substantial rim transitions; tubes read as living volumes rather than straight manufactured pipes. The base has deliberate rock masses and settles around rooted tubes.
priorityOutcomes.comparison: Substantial visible improvement from the source toward fixed target. Exact source counts/topology, target pores/counts and unseen target views are not locks.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: Pink remains dominant, violet remains a readable secondary color, and cobalt grounds the cluster. Tube bodies, open rims, cavity walls and reef planes separate clearly. Optional restrained green/blue-violet low accents may enrich the reef without overtaking the coral.
priorityOutcomes.reject: Muddy joined masses, black cavity plugs, fluorescent white rim burnouts or an unrelated palette.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: Broad soft highlights and gradual body/rock shading describe roundness and rim thickness under horizontally symmetric lighting. Every facing remains coherent and materially readable.
priorityOutcomes.reject: Preferred horizontal key/glint direction, directional ground shadow, target halo imitation, hard flat blank lower bands, clipped whites or unexplained black dead spots.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: A restrained set of visible surface/reef details may convey porous coral and small living growth, supported by consistent material treatment. Details complement rather than replace the larger shapes.
priorityOutcomes.reject: Noisy pitting, repeated stamp-like dots, thin floating specks, texture swimming, incoherent detail scale, or decoration crowding tube mouths.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: At full native size, published2x, logical128px cell and phone32px cell, the tiered pink/violet cluster, hollowness and blue grounding remain readable. Fine detail may naturally disappear at phone scale. Cardinal views are complete coherent sculpture, with no unexplained mouth intrusions or broken rims.
priorityOutcomes.context: Use the actual catalog interaction with submarine/eel and repeated source placement. Preserve foreground reef identity while checking that highlighting/detail does not obscure actor silhouettes. Generic low-contrast metadata is an unresolved wording conflict, not authority to turn it into faint atmospheric background.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: Gentle one-second12fps ambient sway remains rooted in the fixed rubble without visible sliding, popping, exposed basal ends, interpenetration flashes or lighting/texture jumps. All required phases/facings are covered; static is a stable reduced-motion hold, and frame13 closes to frame1.
priorityOutcomes.freedom: Equivalent improved native articulation/pivots may replace weak source implementation if rooted swaying semantics, envelope, cadence and loop are preserved; exact old amplitudes/part count are not blanket locks.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: No frame clipping, alpha halos, external cast-shadow artifacts, z fighting, split faces, abrupt shading seams, lost tube openings, broken contacts or unintended detached geometry on light/gray/dark backdrops.
